name: Boon Of Looming Shadows
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Shadowy Stretch
features.description: When you take the Attack action, your reach for your Melee weapon attacks increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn.

features.name: Dancing Silhouette
features.description: You can take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action.
